ordered_steps: On the existing F-host run 030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1; preserve/start exactly one persistent canonical daemon and verify all four receipts plus fresh heartbeat/claim.
Query National_LIDAR_Programme_index_catalogue for tilename TQ3595, TQ5090 and TQ2570; record only real returned DTM filename, survey dates/id, resolution, year and latest fields.

Query LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents by each exact BNG point using geometryType=esriGeometryPoint, inSR=27700 and intersects; do not infer os_ref granularity; record real flight dates, transform, geoid, filepath, latest and polygon_id.
Use an XML-capable client for EA Composite DTM1m WCS GetCapabilities, record real CoverageId/CRS/formats, then DescribeCoverage before GetCoverage.
Sample real WCS DTM1m pixels inside native HMLR EPSG:27700 index polygons; exclude -3.4028235e+38 NoData; compute median/q1/q3/min/max only from observed pixels.
Call official OS Downloads API productId Terrain50 with area=TQ; require real JSON or archive bytes; verify TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 grid and metadata members before sampling pixel centres.
Run three EA/OS numeric crosschecks and port 8012 readback; keep manual action OPEN until the four recovery receipts plus fresh owner/heartbeat are remotely verified.
